name: Smooth Unsweetened Applesauce Cup
whyItWorks: Cooking and pureeing apples completely removes the tough insoluble peel and hydrolyzes cellular fiber into gentle soluble pectin. It acts like a soothing balm in the colon, binding loose bowel movements and supplying easily absorbed energy.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Select unsweetened or natural varieties without high-fructose corn syrup or chunked pieces. Serve chilled or room temperature.
watchOuts: Choose smooth pureed varieties rather than chunky homestyle applesauce with leftover skin fragments.
